scope: Expiring pending-to-active E2EE recovery-device activation with bounded active-device sets

controls.activation_confirmation: explicit second user action after requesting the local package download
controls.activation_capability_storage: server stores SHA-256 only; idempotency registry response is encrypted at rest
controls.activation_capability_replay: deterministic HMAC bound to user, device and idempotency key
controls.expiry_boundary: expires when current time is greater than or equal to activation_expires_at
controls.legacy_recovery_migration: device:recovery:* rows are idempotently reclassified as recovery
controls.legacy_over_limit_behavior: fail closed with empty device set and null commitment

resolved_findings.finding: Legacy recovery rows inherited the new primary-device default and could no longer be restored.
resolved_findings.resolution: The restart-safe migration reclassifies device:recovery:* rows and a regression test restores the migrated key.

resolved_findings.finding: Generic device registration allowed an unbounded active recipient-device set and unbounded client key derivations.
resolved_findings.resolution: Generic registration and recovery activation enforce a transactional cap of ten active devices per account.

resolved_findings.finding: A legacy database already above the cap was fail-closed for integrity but still read and parsed every active key.
resolved_findings.resolution: Device-set assembly now reads at most cap plus one; the regression fixture places invalid JSON beyond the bounded read.

external_release_gates: trusted HTTPS edge and real-device browser lab

capacity.reason: Goal reports usageLimited; one bounded local packet used one sequential independent checker
